def.zh-tw: 若 $A_1,A_2,\dots,A_n$ 兩兩互斥、聯集是整個樣本空間，且 $P(B)>0$，則 $P(A_k\mid B)=\dfrac{P(A_k)\,P(B\mid A_k)}{P(A_1)\,P(B\mid A_1)+\cdots+P(A_n)\,P(B\mid A_n)}$：由「原因之下結果的機率」反推「看到結果之後原因的機率」。
def.en: If $A_1,A_2,\dots,A_n$ are pairwise mutually exclusive with the whole sample space as their union, and $P(B)>0$, then $P(A_k\mid B)=\dfrac{P(A_k)\,P(B\mid A_k)}{P(A_1)\,P(B\mid A_1)+\cdots+P(A_n)\,P(B\mid A_n)}$: it turns "the probability of the result given each cause" into "the probability of a cause once the result is seen".

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：貝氏定理 Bayes theorem

def.zh-tw: 描述狀態變化的方陣（課綱稱為轉移方陣）：第 $i$ 列第 $j$ 行的元素是「現在在狀態 $j$ 時，下一期到狀態 $i$」的條件機率，所以每個元素都在 $0$ 到 $1$ 之間，每一行的和都是 $1$。
def.en: A square matrix that describes how states change (the curriculum calls it 轉移方陣): the entry in row $i$, column $j$ is the conditional probability of being in state $i$ next time given state $j$ now, so every entry is between $0$ and $1$ and every column adds up to $1$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：轉移矩陣 transition matrix

def.zh-tw: 用二階方陣 $\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix}$ 把平面上的點 $(x,y)$ 變成 $(ax+by,\,cx+dy)$ 的變換；矩陣的第一行是 $(1,0)$ 的像，第二行是 $(0,1)$ 的像。旋轉、鏡射、伸縮都是例子。
def.en: A transformation that uses a $2\times 2$ matrix $\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix}$ to send the point $(x,y)$ to $(ax+by,\,cx+dy)$; the first column of the matrix is the image of $(1,0)$ and the second column the image of $(0,1)$. Rotations, reflections and stretches are examples.

source.locator: 樂詞網 數學名詞：線性變換 linear transformation
